claim_boundary: The short synthetic regressions prove bounded Windows tree/output handling and rejection of the reproduced false Pass after the parent exits. The command starts suspended and is assigned to a private kill-on-close job before resuming; Pass requires parent success, no live job descendants and finished output readers. Timeout terminates the job and polls cleanup for at most two additional seconds. These fixture timings are diagnostic observations, not HydraCache performance claims, full-workspace green evidence, or proof of the precise cause of the earlier 226352-ms overrun.
